primary_title: Characterization of IL-4 and IL-13 signals dependent on the human IL-13 receptor alpha chain 1: redundancy of requirement of tyrosine residue for STAT3 activation
decision_basis: Review-guided primary study supports IL-13-associated STAT3 activation in the exact IL4RA:IL13RA1 receptor-complex context.
limitations_preserved: Preserve IL13RA1 Y402/Y405 site-set and human B-cell model; no STAT3 nuclear translocation, terminal target-gene or SCI inference.
